content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the Chittoor District Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Chittoor District Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 37 vacancies are available - 1 for Record Assistant, 1 for Office Subordinate, 9 for Sweepers, 3 for Scavengers, 14 for Cooks (Male Only), 5 for Dhobis, and 4 for Barbers.

content_sections.heading: Chittoor District Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Record Assistant: 10th Class or equivalent. Office Subordinate: VIIth Class Pass. Sweepers, Scavengers: Must be able to read and write Telugu or Urdu or English or Hindi. Cooks, Dhobis, Barbers: Must be able to read and write Telugu or Urdu or English or Hindi and possess professional skill.

content_sections.heading: Chittoor District Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 42 years Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/BCs/EWS up to a maximum of 47 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Chittoor District Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 15000 Per Month for all posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Chittoor District Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://Chittoor.ap.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chittoor District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Chittoor District Recruitment 2026 is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by Chittoor District?
faq.answer: Chittoor District has announced a total of 37 vacancies for various posts including Record Assistant, Office Subordinate, Sweepers, Scavengers, Cooks, Dhobis, and Barbers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Record Assistant post, candidates must have completed 10th Class or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts is between 18 years to 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Chittoor District.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for all the advertised posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and an Interview. Candidates need to qualify in all stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for Chittoor District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q9. Which language proficiency is required for Sweepers and Scavengers posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Sweepers and Scavengers posts must be able to read and write in Telugu, Urdu, English, or Hindi.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for Chittoor District?
faq.answer: The official website for Chittoor District, where you can find more information and download the application form, is https://Chittoor.ap.gov.in/.
